summary: install.cjs exfiltrates environment and host data on npm install
details: The package's install.cjs lifecycle script runs on npm install and collects host and environment information via require('os') and process.env, then transmits it over HTTPS. The script executes automatically before the installer has interacted with the package, and the data collected includes process.env contents alongside platform identifiers — a fingerprint consistent with install-time environment/credential harvesting rather than legitimate build or configuration work. The package advertises no functionality that would require reading and transmitting the installer's environment variables at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
